user.title: Select region
user.description:
Choose your oblast or a city with special status from Alerts Energy.

Data source: [Alerts Energy]({source_url}). Free access for this integration is provided by the Alerts Energy team.

reconfigure.title: Change location and queue
reconfigure.description:
Choose a region, settlement, operator and exact queue. Existing entity IDs are preserved after the final step.

Data source: [Alerts Energy]({source_url}). Free access for this integration is provided by the Alerts Energy team.

locality.title: Select settlement
locality.description: Current territory: {territory}. Select a district, then a community and your city or village. You can skip this step. Schedules are regional: confirm your operator and queue yourself.

operator.title: Select operator
operator.description: Region: {area}. Choose the operator whose network serves your address. The settlement does not automatically determine your operator or queue.

queue.title: Select exact queue
queue.description: Operator: {operator}. Select the exact queue verified for your address.

abort.already_configured: This region, operator and queue are already configured.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The location, operator and queue have been updated.
abort.invalid_entry: The configuration entry could not be found.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot retrieve Alerts Energy data. Check the connection and try again.
error.no_queues: The source has not published any queues for this operator yet.
error.invalid_queue: This queue is no longer available. Select an exact queue from the list.
error.no_areas: The source returned no regions. Try again later.
error.no_operators: The source has no operators for this region.
error.invalid_selection: This choice is no longer available. Select from the current list.
error.no_localities: The source returned no settlements for this territory. Retry or continue with the regional schedule.

init.title: Polling interval
init.description:
Choose a whole number of minutes from 15 to 1440 (default: 15). Entries in the same region share one request using the shortest interval among entries with polling enabled. Changes apply immediately.

Data source: [Alerts Energy]({source_url}). Free access for this integration is provided by the Alerts Energy team.

error.invalid_scan_interval: Enter a whole number of minutes from 15 to 1440.
